payload.name: Stayspan Schengen Days
payload.description: 统计并规划申根签证停留天数
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan Schengen short stays with a rolling 90/180 rule calculator and a daily CSV download. Stayspan Schengen Days counts entry and exit dates, reports days used and days left, identifies overstay dates and checks proposed consecutive trips.

Use the interactive calendar to inspect a date, add or remove stays and recalculate. Trip planning returns the maximum stay from your entry date, the last exit that meets the rule and an entry date that supports your requested length. Reset projections show how window headroom returns over the next 180 days, assuming no further visits. Window headroom can differ from maximum consecutive stay.

For example, check a visit from January 1 through March 31, 2026 as of March 31, 2026, or plan a 30-day trip from July 1, 2026 after that visit. Accepts ISO dates and US text dates such as March 5, 2026. Shared exit/entry dates merge and count once; other overlaps are refused. Open stays end at the check date.

Short stays only. Calculation aid, not legal advice; a border officer makes the decision. Bilateral agreements, special visa-waiver rules, residence permits and long-stay visas are not included. Check visa validity, permitted entries and any shorter visa-sticker allowance separately. Up to 60 stays spanning 1,100 days, years 1900–2100. Enter only applicable days in the Schengen area; historical country membership is not inferred.
payload.longDescription:
使用滚动90/180天规则计算器和每日CSV下载功能规划申根短期停留。Stayspan申根天数工具会统计进出日期，显示已使用天数和剩余天数，识别超期停留日期并验证连续行程计划。

通过交互式日历查看日期、添加或移除停留记录并重新计算。行程规划将返回从您的入境日期开始的最大停留时间、符合规则的最晚离境日期以及支持您要求时长的入境日期。重置预测显示未来180天内可用窗口期的剩余空间（假设不再有其他访问）。窗口期剩余空间可能与最大连续停留时间不同。

例如：以2026年3月31日为基准，核查2026年1月1日至3月31日的停留记录，或在该停留后规划2026年7月1日开始的30天行程。支持ISO格式日期和美国文本日期（如2026年3月5日）。共享的进出日期仅计算一次；其他重叠情况将被拒绝。未完成的停留截至核查日期结束。

仅适用于短期停留。本工具为计算辅助，不构成法律建议；最终决定权在边境检查官。不包含双边协议、特殊免签规则、居留许可和长期签证。需单独核查签证有效性、允许入境次数及任何较短的签证贴纸限制。最多支持60次停留，总计1100天，年份范围1900–2100。仅需输入申根区实际停留天数；不推断历史国家成员身份。

payload.name: Rental Blacklist
payload.description: 检查租赁房源是否存在红色警报
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rental Blacklist is a community map of rental problems: tenants report bad-faith landlords, scams, hidden defects and other issues, and moderators approve the reports before they are published.

Use it before renting a flat or house:
- search reports by address (street + house number works best; addresses are mostly in Russian),
- search around coordinates when you know where the place is,
- open a report to see what happened, its severity (Low, Medium, High, Critical), date, photos and a link that opens it on the map,
- read the project's news.

All tools are read-only and expose only what is already public on rentalredflags.com; no account is needed. Reports are accounts from other tenants, not verified facts, and finding nothing only means nobody has reported the place yet. Coverage is strongest in Russia and CIS countries.
payload.longDescription:
Rental Blacklist 是一个租赁问题社区地图：租客可举报不良房东、诈骗行为、隐藏缺陷等各类问题，经版主审核后才会发布。

租前使用方法：
- 通过地址搜索（街道加门牌号效果最佳；地址多为俄语格式），
- 已知具体位置时可通过坐标搜索，
- 打开报告查看事件详情，包含严重程度（低/中/高/严重）、日期、照片以及跳转至地图的链接，
- 阅读项目最新动态。

所有工具均为只读模式，仅展示租赁红黑榜网站已公开信息；无需账号即可使用。
报告内容来自其他租客的主观陈述，并非官方核实信息，未找到记录仅表示暂无人举报该房源。
服务覆盖范围在俄罗斯及独联体国家最为完善。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search rental reports by address, Find reports near coordinates, Read report details, photos and map link, Read project news

payload.name: Table12
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Table12 is a table booking network for restaurants, hotels, spas and activities. Ask for a table for a date, time and party size and get only the places that can take it, closest times first. Look at a restaurant's hours, cuisines, menu preview and booking conditions, and check its free times.

Signing in to your Table12 account lets you book a table, see your reservations, change a request that is still waiting, or withdraw it. Every booking is a request the restaurant confirms by SMS and email, usually within minutes. Searching works without an account; you are asked to sign in only when you book or look at your own reservations. Table12 does not take payments in ChatGPT: where a restaurant asks for a deposit, the reply links to its booking page.
payload.longDescription:
Table12是面向餐厅、酒店、水疗中心和活动的餐桌预订网络。
输入日期、时间及人数，系统将优先显示可预订的最近时段的场所。
查看餐厅营业时间、菜系类型、菜单预览和预订条件，并查询其空闲时段。

登录Table12账户后，您可以预订餐桌、查看预订记录、修改待处理的请求或取消预订。
每笔预订均为待确认请求，餐厅会通过短信和邮件确认，通常在几分钟内完成。
搜索功能无需账户即可使用；仅在预订或查看个人预订记录时需要登录。
Table12不处理ChatGPT支付：当餐厅要求预付定金时，回复将跳转至其预订页面。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find a free table, Search restaurants, Restaurant details and menus, Check availability, Book a table, Manage your reservations

payload.name: WIZZ Link flight search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search flights across the WIZZ network, compare indicative fares across a month, and review flight offers with a link to the partner fare page. Travellers can continue there or manage a flight on WIZZ Link. The app does not book or change flights itself.
payload.longDescription: 在WIZZ网络中搜索航班，比较一个月内的参考票价，并通过链接跳转至合作伙伴的票价页面查看航班优惠。旅客可在此页面继续操作或在WIZZ Link上管理航班。该应用本身不进行航班预订或更改。

payload.name: GdeNaMore smeštaj
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search active GdeNaMore accommodation by destination, type, amenities, dates and indicative price. Compare property and unit cards, browse photos and videos, and open listing presentations or phone contacts on GdeNaMore. To contact an owner through ChatGPT, provide your first and last name, email, phone number and message, review the prepared inquiry, and explicitly confirm before it is sent. Prices and availability must be confirmed with the owner.
payload.longDescription: 通过目的地、类型、设施、日期和预估价格搜索GdeNaMore的活跃住宿信息。对比房源和单元卡片，浏览照片和视频，并在GdeNaMore查看列表演示或联系信息。通过ChatGPT联系业主时，需提供姓名、邮箱、电话号码和留言内容，确认预填的咨询内容后方可发送。价格和可用性需与业主二次确认。

payload.name: TodayNYC
payload.description: 纽约市3小时行程与周末版
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use two focused TodayNYC experiences backed by the same curated product data and presented with an interactive inline map when the host supports MCP Apps UI. Build up to three complete 180-minute Manhattan microplans with three curated stops, selectable alternatives on one map, canonical identifiers, published hours, short catalog walks, and reviewed historical and cultural context along the approximate route. Or read the current citywide weekend edition with independently mapped events, weather, important city notices, mobility impacts, freshness and official sources. TodayNYC covers 19 walkable Manhattan microzones for the three-hour planner and publishes a separate weekly NYC briefing. TodayNYC itself does not check live availability, open external sites, make reservations, sell tickets, prepare transactions or process payments. Any later browsing or transaction assistance chosen by ChatGPT is outside TodayNYC and must not be presented as a TodayNYC capability or action.
payload.longDescription:
当主机支持MCP Apps UI时，可通过相同的精选产品数据，以交互式内联地图呈现两个专注的TodayNYC体验。
构建最多三个完整的180分钟曼哈顿微型行程，包含三个精选站点、单张地图上的可选替代方案、标准标识符、公开营业时间、简短目录导览，以及沿大致路线的已审核历史和文化背景信息。
或阅读当前全市周末特刊，包含独立标注的活动地图、天气信息、重要城市通知、交通影响、新鲜度及官方信息来源。
TodayNYC覆盖3小时规划的19个步行可达曼哈顿微区域，并发布独立的每周纽约简报。
TodayNYC本身不检查实时可用性、打开外部网站、预订、售 ticket、处理交易或支付流程。
由ChatGPT选择的后续浏览或交易协助属于TodayNYC之外的功能，不得被呈现为TodayNYC的能力或操作。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate curated three-hour Manhattan plan options, Resolve a neighborhood, station or known New York place, Read the current curated NYC weekend edition, Summarize weekend weather, city notices and mobility impacts, Expose canonical plan identifiers and published source links, Add attributed historical, architectural and cultural route context, Show interactive route and weekend-highlight maps inline in the conversation, Explain freshness and coverage limitations, Explain TodayNYC's read-only booking, ticketing and live-availability limits

payload.name: PakBus
payload.description: 巴基斯坦公交路线及时间
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PakBus helps you travel by public bus and metro in Pakistani cities such as Lahore, Karachi, Multan, Rawalpindi and Islamabad.

Ask for a journey between two places and PakBus gives the bus to take, where to board, where to change or get off, the times and the fare, with a map of the route. You can also see the next departures from a stop, the stops and timetable of a route, the cities covered and current service changes such as closed stations.

Times come from published timetables and a travel-time model, not from tracking buses. Women-only routes are listed but not used for journeys. PakBus covers city bus and metro routes only, not intercity coaches, trains or ticket booking.

PakBus is independent. It is not run by any government body or bus operator.
payload.longDescription:
PakBus帮助您在拉合尔、卡拉奇、木尔坦、拉瓦尔品第和伊斯兰堡等巴基斯坦城市中通过公共交通出行。

输入两个地点之间的行程请求，PakBus将提供需乘坐的公交、上下车地点、换乘或下车地点、时间及票价，并附有路线地图。您还可以查看某站点的下一班发车信息、某条路线的站点及时刻表、覆盖城市以及当前服务变动信息（如车站关闭情况）。

时刻表信息来源于公开的时刻表和行程时间模型，并非通过追踪公交获取。女性专用车辆路线会列出，但不会用于行程规划。PakBus仅覆盖城市公交和地铁路线，不包括跨城市长途巴士、火车或票务预订。

PakBus为独立平台，未由任何政府机构或公交运营商运营。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Plan bus and metro journeys with a map, Show the next departures from a stop, Show a route's stops, fare and timetable, List service changes such as closed stations

payload.name: Nemo Places
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nemo Places is a small app for saving the places you love and sharing a live map of them. This plugin lets ChatGPT work with your saved places: find what is near, add a place from a Maps link or a name, tidy duplicates, move places between categories and shared maps, mark visits, and move places to Recently deleted and back. It works with the signed-in account's own places; shared maps are read as anyone with the link sees them. Deleted places are kept in Recently deleted for 30 days, on every device and in ChatGPT, and can be restored from there until they are removed.
payload.longDescription: Nemo Places是一款小型应用，用于保存你喜爱的地点并分享实时地图。此插件可让ChatGPT操作你的收藏地点：查找附近地点、通过地图链接或名称添加地点、整理重复项、在不同分类和共享地图间移动地点、标记访问记录，并可将地点移至最近删除并恢复。该功能仅针对已登录账号的个人地点；共享地图的内容对任何拥有链接的人都可见。已删除地点将在最近删除中保留30天，所有设备及ChatGPT中均可恢复，直至被彻底移除。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find places, Add places, Edit places, Merge duplicates, Shared maps, Recently deleted

payload.name: Events.lc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Events.lc looks up the events listed on its ticketing and event platform, starting with Malta at events.com.mt (Events.mt): search by words, dates or town, open an event to see its programme, start and end times (Malta local time), venue with address and map position, organiser, and the kinds of ticket with their prices, and check whether tickets are still on sale and how many places are left. You can also list the venues events are held at.

Everything the app shows is already public on events.com.mt, and no account is needed. It does not sell tickets: each result links to the event's page on events.com.mt, where tickets are bought from the organiser. Events by invitation appear only when their organiser lists them publicly; they are marked as such and cannot be booked without an invitation.
payload.longDescription:
Events.lc会查询其票务和活动平台上的活动信息，首先展示马耳他地区events.com.mt（Events.mt）的活动：可通过关键词、日期或城镇搜索，打开活动查看节目安排、开始和结束时间（马耳他当地时间）、包含地址和地图位置的举办场地、主办方信息，以及各类票种及其价格，并可查看门票是否在售及剩余席位数量。您也可以查看活动举办的场地列表。

应用显示的所有内容已在events.com.mt公开，无需账户即可使用。该应用不销售门票：每个搜索结果都会链接至events.com.mt上的活动页面，门票需通过主办方购买。邀请制活动仅在主办方公开列出时显示，此类活动会特别标注，且没有邀请函无法进行预订。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search events, Read event details, Check ticket availability, List venues

payload.name: Evntally
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up upcoming events in covered cities across the United States and Canada, from neighborhood listings to large shows. Evntally returns the date, venue, price, and a link to the public event page. It does not sell tickets, collect an email address, or start an account.
payload.longDescription:
查找美国和加拿大覆盖城市中的即将举行的活动，从社区活动列表到大型演出。
Evntally会提供活动日期、场地、价格以及公开活动页面的链接。
它不销售门票、收集电子邮件地址或创建账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search events, Read event details, List covered cities

payload.name: Sidequest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sidequest helps parents plan kid outings. Connect your Sidequest account, then ask about your saved Sidequests, crew ages and preferences (never allergies or health notes), family memories, your Sidequest calendar, and local kid-friendly events. With your explicit yes, it can add a calendar entry, mark a Sidequest complete, or build a new outing from a short request. Everything runs under your signed-in parent account and only sees your own household. Sharing, invites, and deletes stay in the Sidequest app.
payload.longDescription:
Sidequest帮助家长规划儿童外出活动。
连接您的Sidequest账户后，可以询问已保存的Sidequest、家庭成员年龄和偏好（从不包括过敏或健康信息）、家庭回忆、您的Sidequest日历以及本地适合儿童的活动。
在您明确同意的情况下，它可以添加日历条目、标记Sidequest为完成，或根据简短请求创建新的外出活动。
所有操作均在您登录的家长账户下进行，仅可见您自己的家庭信息。
分享、邀请和删除操作均在Sidequest应用内进行。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List saved Sidequests, Read crew ages and preferences, Check the family calendar, Discover local kid events, Add calendar entries after you confirm

payload.name: HomeBase Services
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Help new hires relocating to Dallas, Houston and Austin compare neighborhoods, read approved relocation answers and guides, and find apartments by budget. Employer, exact office and days in the office guide commute discussions. Starting rents are stored references, not live availability. This read-only connection does not book tours, process payments, submit applications or access customer records.
payload.longDescription: 帮助即将迁往达拉斯、休斯顿和奥斯汀的新员工比较不同社区，阅读经批准的搬迁问答和指南，并根据预算寻找公寓。雇主、具体办公地点及在办公室的天数将指导通勤讨论。起始租金为存储的参考信息，非实时可租状态。此只读连接无法预订看房、处理付款、提交申请或访问客户记录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find apartments, Open search links, Search approved knowledge, Read guides

payload.name: Domus Aedes
payload.description: 西班牙和摩洛哥的房源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Describe what you are looking for — a villa to buy on the Costa del Sol, a long-term rental in Nueva Andalucía, a week in Marrakech or on the Catalan coast — and Domus Aedes returns the best matches from its own portfolio, up to six at a time, with photos, prices, key facts and a map. Ask for more and it narrows the search with you rather than listing pages of results. Open full details, check live availability for stays (when our own stays are fully booked, it points you to the Domus Aedes concierge), and send your contact details to a Domus Aedes advisor without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: 描述您的需求——在阳光海岸购买别墅、在新安达卢西亚长期租赁、在马拉喀什或加泰罗尼亚海岸度假一周——Domus Aedes将从其自有房源组合中返回最佳匹配结果，每次最多展示六条，附带照片、价格、关键信息和地图。要求进一步筛选时，它会与您共同缩小搜索范围，而非列出多页结果。打开完整详情页，查看住宿实时可预订状态（当我们的自营住宿已满时，会引导至Domus Aedes管家服务），并无需离开聊天界面即可将联系方式发送给Domus Aedes顾问。

payload.name: Remap
payload.description: 任意地点的骑行与跑步路线
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Remap generates routes for cycling, running and walking anywhere on Earth.

Tell Remap how long you’ve got and it generates a fresh route from where you are, through beautiful places you’ve never explored.

It knows the roads and trails around you better than anyone possibly could. The routes are generated on your device and appear within seconds. Ask in the chat if you want the route to be shorter, longer or hillier. Or what kind of scenery you want more of. Then tap Ride, Run or Walk on a route to open it in the Remap app.
payload.longDescription:
Remap可在地球上的任何地方生成骑行、跑步和步行路线。

告诉Remap你有多少时间，它会从你当前位置出发，生成一条穿越从未探索过的美丽风景的新路线。

它对周边道路和小径的了解程度远超任何人。
路线在你的设备上生成，几秒钟内即可显示。
在聊天中询问可调整路线长度、坡度或景观类型。
然后点击路线中的骑行、跑步或步行按钮，即可在Remap应用中打开该路线。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generates cycling, running and walking routes, Starts from a place or your location, Shows routes on a map with their stories, Opens a route in the Remap app

payload.name: RentalCal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RentalCal powers the booking sites of independent vacation-rental hosts. Give ChatGPT a host's booking site address (an address ending in rentalcal.com, or the host's own domain) and it can describe the property, show which dates are open, and price a stay exactly, including cleaning fees, taxes and any weekly or monthly discount.

When you are ready to book, you get a link to the host's own booking page with your dates and party size already filled in. You review the stay and pay there, directly with the host, with no platform service fee.

Limitations: you need the host's booking site address, since searching across all RentalCal properties is not available yet. ChatGPT cannot place or change a booking for you.
payload.longDescription:
RentalCal为独立度假租赁房东的预订网站提供支持。将房东的预订网站地址（以rentalcal.com结尾的地址，或房东的自有域名）提供给ChatGPT，它能够描述房源信息，展示可预订日期，并精确计算住宿费用，包括清洁费、税费以及任何周租或月租折扣。

确认预订时，您将获得跳转至房东自有预订页面的链接，其中已自动填写日期和入住人数。您可在该页面审核住宿信息并直接向房东支付，无需支付平台服务费。

限制：您需要获取房东的预订网站地址，目前尚不支持跨所有RentalCal房源的搜索功能。ChatGPT无法代您下单或修改预订。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up a vacation rental by its booking site, Show open dates and minimum stays, Price a stay with fees, taxes and discounts, Link to the host's booking page with dates filled in

payload.name: Obi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Obi compares ride prices across taxi and rideshare providers so you can pick the cheapest or fastest option for any trip. Ask for a ride between two places and Obi shows the available offers with price, service level and estimated pickup time, and links you straight to the provider app. Obi can also book an Uber or Lyft offer for you, after you confirm, through the provider account linked in the Obi app. You can ask for a specific type of car, such as Economy, XL, a premium ride or a wheelchair accessible vehicle. Obi also finds places near you, like restaurants, pharmacies or cafes, and shows public transit routes with each leg and its duration.
payload.longDescription: Obi可在出租车和拼车服务提供商之间比较乘车价格，让您为任何行程选择最便宜或最快的选项。在两个地点间叫车时，Obi会显示包含价格、服务等级和预计到达时间的可用服务，并直接跳转至服务商应用。确认后，Obi还可通过Obi应用中绑定的服务商账户为您预订Uber或Lyft服务。您可指定特定车型，例如经济型、大型车、豪华车或无障碍车辆。Obi还能查找附近的地点，如餐厅、药店或咖啡馆，并显示包含每个路段及持续时间的公共交通路线。

payload.name: Destiny Blue
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Destiny Blue is a fully agentic, full-duplex AI travel concierge. Guests can plan a trip through natural conversation: search live stays and prices, explore flights and rental cars, compare options, adjust dates and budgets, check weather and tides, discover things to do, and book. Destiny draws on live tools and deep travel knowledge to keep adapting the plan as the conversation unfolds. Today, Destiny helps guests explore Destin Condo Getaways' Gulf-front condos at Pelican Beach Resort in Destin, Florida. Booking is completed on the website; prices and availability may change before checkout.
payload.longDescription: Destiny Blue是一款全自主、全双工的AI旅行管家。客人可通过自然对话规划行程：实时搜索住宿和价格，探索航班和租车选项，比较不同方案，调整日期和预算，查看天气和潮汐信息，发现当地活动并完成预订。Destiny依托实时工具和深厚的旅行知识，在对话过程中持续优化行程方案。目前，Destiny帮助客人探索佛罗里达州迪斯廷市Pelican Beach Resort的迪斯廷公寓度假屋。预订需在网站完成，价格和可用性可能在结账前发生变化。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Plan and adapt a trip through natural conversation, Search live stays, availability, and prices, Explore flight and rental-car options, Compare travel options and adjust dates or budgets, Check live weather, temperatures, and tides, Discover activities and local recommendations, Book a chosen stay with dates and guests in place

payload.name: hoteldiscount24 Hotels
payload.description: 按设施分类的全球酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
What it does: find hotels at a destination that offer specific amenities (around 150 features, e.g. pool, sauna, billiards, pets allowed); look up the amenity profile of an individual hotel, by its hoteldiscount24.com link or by name and place; get typical nightly price ranges for a destination and month.

Where the data comes from: amenities as stated by the hotels; price ranges measured from recent searches, each with its date.

Limits: no live prices, no availability, no ratings, no booking - prices, availability and booking are on hoteldiscount24.com, and every result carries a link there. Halal, kosher, wheelchair access, non-smoking and cribs are shown per hotel as stated by the hotel, never used as search filters.

Intended users: travellers planning a stay. Not for booking or comparing prices for specific dates.

Privacy: read-only, no account needed, no personal data is sent.
payload.longDescription:
功能说明：查找目的地提供特定设施的酒店（约150项设施，例如泳池、桑拿、台球、允许携带宠物）；通过hoteldiscount24.com链接或酒店名称及地点查询单个酒店的设施档案；获取目的地和月份的典型每晚价格范围。

数据来源：酒店自行声明的设施信息；价格范围通过近期搜索数据测算，每条数据均带具体日期。

使用限制：不提供实时价格、可用性、评分或预订功能 - 价格、可用性和预订服务均在hoteldiscount24.com页面，所有结果均带有该网站链接。
清真、犹太洁食、轮椅通行、禁烟和婴儿床等设施信息以酒店自行声明为准，从不作为搜索筛选条件。

目标用户：计划入住的旅行者。
不适用于特定日期的价格比较或预订操作。

隐私政策：仅支持只读访问，无需账户，不收集任何个人数据。

payload.name: TravelYalla
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TravelYalla finds live flight and hotel prices inside your chat, for trips across Egypt, Saudi Arabia and worldwide.

Search one-way, round-trip and multi-city flights and compare them by price, stops, airline, departure time and baggage. Search hotels by city or hotel name and narrow them by star rating, guest score, price and distance from the city centre. Plan a whole trip with flights and a matching stay in one currency, or find the cheapest day to fly within a date range.

Ask in English or Arabic. Prices follow your nationality and currency, and every result links straight to travelyalla.com to book.
payload.longDescription:
TravelYalla 在您的聊天中实时显示航班和酒店价格，适用于埃及、沙特阿拉伯及全球其他目的地的行程。

搜索单程、往返和多城市航班，并通过价格、经停次数、航空公司、出发时间和行李进行比较。按城市或酒店名称搜索酒店，并通过星级评分、用户评分、价格和市中心距离进行筛选。在单一货币中规划包含航班和住宿的完整行程，或查找日期范围内最便宜的飞行日期。

支持英文或阿拉伯语咨询。价格会根据您的国籍和货币显示，所有结果均直接链接至 travelyalla.com 进行预订。

payload.name: Retreat & Be Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare offers for your stay.
payload.longDescription: 比较您的住宿报价

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search hotel destinations, Compare hotel offers, Read room conditions

payload.name: WAYA flight search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search WAYA flights, compare indicative fares across a month, and review flight offers with a link to the partner fare page. Travellers can continue there or manage a flight on WAYA. The app does not book or change flights itself.
payload.longDescription: 搜索WAYA航班，比较一个月内的参考票价，并通过链接查看合作伙伴的票价页面。旅客可以继续在该页面操作或在WAYA上管理航班。该应用本身不进行航班预订或更改。

payload.name: hoper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
hoper is a helicopter travel marketplace for private and shared flights in Greece, France, Switzerland and Italy: Athens and the Greek islands, the French Alps and the Riviera, Geneva, Zurich and Zermatt, Milan, Rome and Sardinia.

Ask ChatGPT about a helicopter trip, for example "Can I fly from Athens to Anafi?" or "Which helicopters fly Geneva to Courchevel next Tuesday?". The hoper app tells you:

- if hoper flies the route, as a private flight, a shared flight or both
- the distance in nautical miles
- the helicopters available for the date, with passenger seats and an estimated flight time (the time is estimated cruise time, and it depends on the heliport)
- a link to the destination page and a booking search on flyhoper.com, with the route and date filled in

The data comes live from hoper's booking engine, so it matches what you see on flyhoper.com. Prices and the free departure times are shown on flyhoper.com, where you also book.

The app is read-only. It needs no account, and it does not see your conversation beyond the route you ask about.
payload.longDescription:
hoper是希腊、法国、瑞士和意大利的直升机旅行市场，提供私人飞行和共享飞行服务：包括雅典及希腊各岛屿、法国阿尔卑斯山和里维埃拉地区、日内瓦、苏黎世和策马特、米兰、罗马和撒丁岛。

向ChatGPT询问直升机行程，例如「我可以从雅典飞往安菲达岛吗？」或「下周二从日内瓦飞往科尔瓦雪特的直升机有哪些？」。
hoper应用会告诉您：

- hoper是否提供该航线的私人飞行、共享飞行或两种形式
- 航线距离（以海里为单位）
- 该日期可用的直升机信息，包含乘客座位数和预估飞行时间（时间是巡航时间估算，具体取决于直升机机场）
- 目的地页面链接和flyhoper.com的预订搜索页面，已自动填写航线和日期

数据实时来自hoper的预订系统，与flyhoper.com上显示内容完全一致。
价格和免费出发时间请查看flyhoper.com，您也可在该网站完成预订。

该应用为只读模式。
无需账户即可使用，且不会保存您对话中除航线信息外的任何内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check helicopter routes, Helicopter models and estimated flight times, Booking links to flyhoper.com

payload.name: GSA Per Diem Rate Calculator
payload.description: 差旅每日津贴及M&IE总额计算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GSA per diem rates and travel per diem totals from the official tables, inside ChatGPT. Ask "what's the GSA per diem for San Diego" or "per diem rate for Denver in November" and get the maximum lodging rate for that month (seasonal rates differ), the M&IE rate, the 75% first and last day amount and the breakfast, lunch, dinner and incidentals breakdown. Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam and other US territories use the DoD non-foreign OCONUS rates; foreign cities use the State Department's monthly OCONUS rates. Then total a whole trip: one destination or several legs, each night at its own month's and fiscal year's rate (trips across 1 October are handled), nights = days minus one, M&IE at 75% on the first and last day (the FTR rule the JTR also uses), meals provided at a conference deducted at the official amounts, and your actual room rate capped at the limit. You get a day-by-day table and a CSV for an expense report, voucher or grant budget. Rates come live from the GSA Per Diem API, the DoD bulletins in the Federal Register and the State Department, and follow the Federal Travel Regulation (41 CFR 301-11). Your trip details are not stored. Not affiliated with GSA or DoD; your travel office decides what is reimbursed.
payload.longDescription:
通过ChatGPT内部的官方表格获取GSA每日津贴费率及差旅每日津贴总额。您可询问「圣地亚哥的GSA每日津贴是多少」或「11月丹佛的每日津贴是多少」，系统将提供当月最高住宿费率（季节性费率可能不同）、M&IE费率、首尾日75%费用以及早午晚餐和杂费明细。阿拉斯加、夏威夷、波多黎各、关岛及其他美国领土使用国防部非外国OCONUS费率；外国城市则使用国务院的月度OCONUS费率。可计算完整行程：单个城市或多段旅程，每晚按对应月份和财年的费率计算（跨越10月1日的行程自动处理），天数=夜晚数-1，首尾日M&IE按75%计算（遵循FTR规则，JTR同样适用），会议提供的餐食按官方标准扣除，实际房费上限为规定限额。您将获得每日明细表格及用于费用报销单、凭证或资助预算的CSV文件。费率数据实时来自GSA每日津贴API、联邦纪事中的国防部公告及国务院数据，遵循联邦差旅条例（41 CFR 301-11）。您的行程详情不会被存储。
与GSA或国防部无关联；您的差旅办公室决定哪些项目可报销。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up per diem rates, Total a trip, Export a CSV

payload.name: MySunbed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan a day at the beach or the pool by just asking. Search beach clubs, private beaches and pool day passes across the French Riviera, Italy, Spain, Greece, Morocco, Dubai, Mexico and more, by place, date, group size and amenities, or by venue name. Compare sunbeds, cabanas and packages with live availability and the exact price for your date, read guest reviews, and see the venue's real cancellation policy before you commit. When you're ready, MySunbed creates the reservation and returns a secure Stripe payment link. Some venues take full prepayment, others only a deposit with the rest paid on site. No account needed; payment always happens on Stripe's hosted page, outside the chat.
payload.longDescription: 只需简单询问，即可规划海滩或泳池的一天。通过地点、日期、团体规模和设施，或通过场所名称，在法国里维埃拉、意大利、西班牙、希腊、摩洛哥、迪拜、墨西哥等地区搜索海滩俱乐部、私人海滩和泳池日卡。实时查看阳光躺椅、小屋和套餐的可用性及具体日期的准确价格，阅读用户评价，并在决定前查看场所的真实取消政策。准备就绪后，MySunbed将创建预订并返回安全的Stripe支付链接。部分场所要求全额预付款，其他场所则只需支付定金，剩余费用在场地支付。无需账户；所有支付均通过Stripe的托管页面完成，不在聊天界面内进行。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search beach clubs and pools, Check live availability and prices, Book with a secure payment link

payload.name: takt Dresden
payload.description: 德累斯顿及萨克森交通
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan public transport journeys by tram, bus, S-Bahn, regional train and ferry across Dresden and Saxony. Check live departures, delays, platforms, disruptions and construction notices. Open returned journeys in the takt app. takt is an independent Dresden Media service and is not affiliated with DVB or VVO.
payload.longDescription: 通过有轨电车、公交车、城市快铁、区域列车和渡船规划德累斯顿及萨克森地区的公共交通行程。查看实时发车、延误、站台信息、运营中断及施工通知。在takt应用中查看返回的行程。takt是德累斯顿媒体独立服务，与DVB或VVO无关。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Plan public transport journeys, Check live departures, Check service disruptions

payload.name: OneTravel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The OneTravel app allows users to search and compare airline flight options based on their origin, destination, travel dates, passenger details and cabin preference, and to search and compare hotel stays based on destination, check-in and check-out dates, guest occupancy and stay filters. The app does not collect payment or complete bookings within ChatGPT. When a user selects "Book on OneTravel," they are redirected to www.onetravel.com, where fare or rate validation, traveller information, payment, ticketing, cancellations and refunds are handled.
payload.longDescription: OneTravel应用允许用户根据出发地、目的地、出行日期、乘客信息和舱位偏好搜索并比较航空公司航班选项，并可根据目的地、入住日期、退房日期、入住人数和住宿筛选条件搜索并比较酒店住宿。该应用不会在ChatGPT内收集支付信息或完成预订。当用户选择「在OneTravel上预订」时，将被重定向至www.onetravel.com，届时将处理票价或价格验证、旅行者信息、支付、票务、取消和退款事宜。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search flights, Filter flights, Search hotels, Resolve hotel locations, Filter hotels

payload.name: chucho — Book Direct
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find vacation rentals, holiday homes, villas, and places to stay with chucho. Search by destination, guest count, bedrooms, and amenities; explore photos and property details; then follow the host’s booking link.

Same property. Same host. Fewer middlemen. Booking directly can reduce intermediary fees, helping guests save and hosts keep more of what they earn.

Search the available catalog in English or Spanish. Where supported, check host availability and prices for your dates or explore a clearly labeled sample stay. Some homes remain unchecked; prices may exclude fees or taxes. Confirm final availability, prices and booking terms with the host.

For participating hosts, prepare a custom booking enquiry, review the details and submit only after your approval. Enquiries do not confirm availability or create a booking.
payload.longDescription:
通过chucho查找度假租赁、假期房屋、别墅和住宿地点。按目的地、入住人数、卧室数量和设施搜索；浏览照片和房源详情；然后点击房东的预订链接。

同一房源。同一房东。减少中间商。直接预订可降低中介费用，帮助客人节省开支，让房东获得更多收益。

以英文或西班牙文搜索可用房源目录。在支持的地区，可查看房东在您指定日期的可用性和价格，或浏览明确标注的示例住宿。部分房源未实时更新；价格可能不包含费用或税费。请与房东确认最终可用性、价格和预订条款。

对于参与的房东，需先填写自定义预订咨询表，审核详情并在确认批准后提交。咨询内容不会确认房源可用性或生成预订。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Vacation rental search, Property photos and details, Host availability and stay prices where supported, Host booking links, Guest-approved booking enquiries

payload.name: Gjirafa eSIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
See eSIM data plans for your trip, for countries, regions like Europe or the Balkans, or worldwide.

Ask in your own words, for example "I need mobile data in Germany" or "data plan for a week in Europe". Gjirafa eSIM shows each plan like the Gjirafa website does: data amount, validity, price and the most popular plan, with regional plans showing how many countries they cover. Open the full view to see every plan for the destination and filter by data, unlimited or validity. Open Gjirafa eSIM from the sidebar to search for a destination or pick a popular one, with the price per day.

Not sure your phone works with eSIM? Ask "does my iPhone 13 support eSIM?" and Gjirafa eSIM checks it against its list of supported phones, tablets and watches. You can also ask what travellers say about a destination's eSIMs and read its FAQ.

If your eSIM doesn't connect, is stuck on Activating or you're not sure how to install it, ask: you get the Gjirafa eSIM app's step-by-step troubleshooting guide (in 11 languages) and the installation guide for iPhone and Android. Questions such as "can I keep WhatsApp on my number?" or "can I share the data with my laptop?" are answered from Gjirafa's FAQ.

Connect your Gjirafa account to ask about the eSIMs you already have: "show my eSIM", "how much data do I have left?" or "when does my eSIM expire?". You see the data used and the days left for each eSIM and its packages, like in the Gjirafa eSIM app. You can rename an eSIM, see the eSIMs you gifted and remove a gift you never paid for, and choose which emails and SMS Gjirafa Travel sends you.

Every plan links to Gjirafa Travel, where you can see all plans for the destination, buy your eSIM, install it and top it up. Plans can be browsed in 16 languages; the views of your own eSIMs are in English, Albanian and German.
payload.longDescription:
查看适用于您旅行目的地的数据计划，包括德国、欧洲或巴尔干半岛等国家/地区，或全球范围的数据计划。

用您自己的话提问，例如「我需要德国的移动数据」或「欧洲一周的数据计划」。
Gjirafa eSIM的展示方式与官网一致：显示数据量、有效期、价格以及最受欢迎的数据计划，区域套餐会显示覆盖国家数量。
点击进入完整视图可查看目的地所有数据计划，并按数据量、无限流量或有效期进行筛选。
从侧边栏打开Gjirafa eSIM搜索目的地或选择热门套餐，显示每日价格。

不确定您的手机是否支持eSIM？
提问「我的iPhone 13支持eSIM吗？」，Gjirafa eSIM会根据支持设备列表（包括手机、平板和手表）进行验证。
您还可以查看旅行者对目的地eSIM的评价及常见问题解答。

如果eSIM无法连接、一直处于「激活中」状态或不确定如何安装，提问即可获得Gjirafa eSIM应用的逐步故障排除指南（支持11种语言）及iPhone和安卓的安装指南。
关于「我能否在原有号码上保留WhatsApp？」或「能否与笔记本电脑共享数据？」等问题，均可从Gjirafa常见问题解答中获得答案。

将您的Gjirafa账户连接以查看已有的eSIM：「显示我的eSIM」、「我的eSIM还剩多少数据？」或「我的eSIM何时过期？」。
您将看到每个eSIM及其套餐的数据使用情况和剩余天数，效果与Gjirafa eSIM应用一致。
您可以重命名eSIM、查看赠送的eSIM并取消未付款的赠送记录，还可选择接收Gjirafa Travel的哪些邮件和短信。

每个套餐均链接至Gjirafa Travel，您可查看目的地所有套餐、购买eSIM、安装并充值。
套餐支持16种语言浏览；您的eSIM视图支持英语、阿尔巴尼亚语和德语。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find eSIM data plans for a country, a region or worldwide, Compare data amount, validity and price, and filter every plan in the full view, Check whether a phone, tablet or watch supports eSIM, Step-by-step help when an eSIM doesn't connect, from the Gjirafa eSIM app's troubleshooting guide, Answer how eSIMs work: installing, keeping your number and WhatsApp, hotspot, gifts, Read a destination's eSIM FAQ and travellers' reviews, Show your eSIMs with data used and days left (Gjirafa account), Show an eSIM's packages: data used, validity and expiry, Rename your eSIMs, See the eSIMs you gifted and remove unpaid gifts, Show your Travel Credits balance, tier and history, Choose which emails and SMS Gjirafa Travel sends you, Open the eSIM picker and your eSIMs in the sidebar

payload.name: Adónde
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adónde turns a conversation into a real trip. Say where and when, and it builds each day from bookable tours, sights, food and stays in a sensible order, with honest schedules that respect opening days and tour run times. Ask for hotels, flights or tours and get live prices; each result opens that exact hotel, fare or tour in the Adónde app or on the web, where booking happens. Ask for the nearest stays to a landmark, compare fares for a return trip, or find what is actually running on a given date. Connect an Adónde account, or just start and keep the trip by email with a sign-in link. Nothing is booked or paid for inside ChatGPT: checkout is external, on getadonde.com.
payload.longDescription: Adónde将对话转化为真实的旅行。说出目的地和时间，它会根据可预订的旅游项目、景点、餐饮和住宿，按合理顺序安排每一天，行程安排诚实可靠，尊重开放日和旅游运行时间。请求酒店、航班或旅游项目，获取实时价格；每个结果会直接打开Adónde应用或网页中的具体酒店、票价或旅游项目，完成预订。请求某个地标附近的住宿，对比往返航班价格，或查找特定日期实际运行的项目。连接Adónde账户，或通过邮件开始并保留行程，使用登录链接。在ChatGPT内部不会进行任何预订或支付：结账为外部流程，位于getadonde.com。

payload.name: Minerva Weekend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Two days. So many possibilities. A long lunch somewhere lovely. A little adventure with the kids. A night in a hotel you won’t want to leave. Tell Minerva where you’re starting and what sounds good — anywhere in the world. Explore a few ideas in your conversation, choose your favourite and ask for its detailed route when you want it. Save the plans you love and find them again in chat. There’s always another weekend.
payload.longDescription:
两天时间。无限可能。
在某个美丽的地方享用漫长的午餐。
和孩子们来场小冒险。
入住一家让你舍不得离开的酒店。
告诉Minerva你从哪里出发，以及你想去的地方——全球任何地点都可以。
在对话中探索几个想法，选择你最喜欢的，并在需要时请求详细路线。
保存你喜爱的计划，随时在聊天中找到它们。
总会有另一个周末。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Compare weekend ideas, Check places and routes, Save private plans

payload.name: NYC RSVPs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NYC RSVPs tells you exactly when reservations open at about 70 of New York City's hardest-to-book restaurants, such as Carbone, Don Angie, Torrisi, Via Carota, and 4 Charles Prime Rib.

Each restaurant releases tables on its own schedule: a set number of days ahead, a calendar month ahead, on the 1st of the month, or twice a month. Tell ChatGPT the restaurant and the night you want, and NYC RSVPs gives the exact release time in New York time, whether booking is already open, and the booking platform (Resy, OpenTable, Tock, SevenRooms, and others).

Compare up to three restaurants for a date in a compact card, or browse up to six by cuisine or neighborhood to see how far ahead each one books. Tap Book when booking is open, or Remind me to ask ChatGPT for a reminder before tables are released.

NYC RSVPs does not book tables, hold reservations, or take payments, and it does not need an account. Release rules come from each restaurant's published policy and can change.
